title: Nintendo’s next two Direct events are both happening next week
summary: Nintendo’s Directs are scheduled for 10AM ET on September 8th and 9th, with a Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary event going first. Nintendo just announced two Direct events for next week , scheduled back to back.
